7-9-23
Reported a hit while turning left at an intersection, with the other vehicle coming straight through on a green light. The
claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
7-29-23
Reviewed photos from the scene and the vehicle damage, which lines up with the impact described by the claimant
and the other driver. Two independent witnesses gave accounts that match the sequence of events.
9-9-23
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests any damage to the vehicle predates the policy start.
9-16-23
The claimant reports a concussion with headaches and light sensitivity, which is a plausible injury for a side imapct of
this kind. No prior injury to the head or neck is known from records reviewed so far.
10-2-23
Treatment has followed a typical course, with visits tapering as symptoms eased. It remains unclear from the
statements exactly where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at impact, and this is being clarified with counsel.
12-9-23
The claimant has given the same account in each conversation, and the attorney has confirmed the medical records
are being sent. File remains open pending receipt of the treatment summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
